files.description: Gitignore-style patterns selecting the context files to lint. Defaults to AGENTS.md, AGENT.md, CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md and GEMINI.md in any directory.

categories.description: Severity for all rules in a category.

context/no-missing-path.description: Referenced files and directories (in code spans and @imports) must exist

ignore.description: Glob patterns of referenced paths to skip.

allowSuffixMatch.description: Accept a path if any project path ends with it (e.g. `components/Button.tsx` matches `apps/web/src/components/Button.tsx`).

checkImports.description: Check `@path/to/file.md` imports used by CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md.
